infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: CrowdICE uses the camera so you can photograph river ice conditions for your observations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: CrowdICE needs access to your photos so you can attach an existing picture to a river-ice observation.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: CrowdICE uses your location to tag where a river-ice observation was made.
